assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_58746b3da13ac26.text: Today, I'm at the Vivid Sydney Festival, which has been held in Australia every year since 2009.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_58746b3da13ac26.zh: 今天，我在悉尼缤纷节现场；该节日自2009年起每年都在澳大利亚举办。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_58746b3da13ac26.text: It's held for three weeks during May and June.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_58746b3da13ac26.zh: 活动在5月和6月间举行三周。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_58746b3da13ac26.text: It has loads of activities with music, food, art and learning.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_58746b3da13ac26.zh: 这里有大量与音乐、美食、艺术和学习有关的活动。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_58746b3da13ac26.text: Anybody can go to the lectures,
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_58746b3da13ac26.zh: 任何人都可以参加讲座，

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_58746b3da13ac26.text: see the lights and eat interesting food.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_58746b3da13ac26.zh: 欣赏灯光，品尝有趣的食物。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_58746b3da13ac26.text: The festival gets bigger every year.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_58746b3da13ac26.zh: 这个节日一年比一年盛大。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_58746b3da13ac26.text: Sometimes over two million people come.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_58746b3da13ac26.zh: 有时会有两百多万人到来。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_7f22dadf47f04a9.text: We asked one of the visitors about the festival.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_7f22dadf47f04a9.zh: 我们询问了一位游客对这个节日的看法。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_7f22dadf47f04a9.text: Can you introduce yourself and tell me, is this your first time at the festival here in Sydney?
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_7f22dadf47f04a9.zh: 你能介绍一下自己，并告诉我这是你第一次参加悉尼的这个节日吗？

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_7f22dadf47f04a9.text: My name is Olivia and no,
Why do you like coming to the festival?
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_7f22dadf47f04a9.zh: 你为什么喜欢来这个节日？

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_7f22dadf47f04a9.text: Well, it's an interesting event to come to.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_7f22dadf47f04a9.zh: 嗯，这是一个很有意思的活动。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_7f22dadf47f04a9.text: It's great for children and adults.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_7f22dadf47f04a9.zh: 它对儿童和成年人都很棒。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_7f22dadf47f04a9.text: I enjoy learning about all the new ideas people have on important topics.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_7f22dadf47f04a9.zh: 我喜欢了解人们针对重要话题提出的各种新想法。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_7f22dadf47f04a9.text: We don't get much time to really think or learn about new things in everyday life, but you can do exactly that at this festival.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_7f22dadf47f04a9.zh: 在日常生活中，我们很少有时间真正思考或学习新事物，但在这个节日上你恰好可以这样做。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_ef862dd056804f1.text: So what kinds of things do people learn and do here?
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_ef862dd056804f1.zh: 那么人们在这里会了解和做些什么？

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_ef862dd056804f1.text: Do people try mainly one type of thing?
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_ef862dd056804f1.zh: 人们主要只尝试一种活动吗？

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_ef862dd056804f1.text: most people plan on going to several events.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_ef862dd056804f1.zh: 大多数人计划参加好几个活动。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_ef862dd056804f1.text: For example, today I learned about nature.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_ef862dd056804f1.zh: 例如，今天我了解了自然。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_ef862dd056804f1.text: I went to a lecture about the sea and new ways to clean it.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_ef862dd056804f1.zh: 我去听了一场有关海洋以及清理海洋新方法的讲座。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_be256a589dfdc7c.text: Today I am talking with Yuki.
She sells food during the Cherry Blossom Festival in Ueno Park in Tokyo.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_be256a589dfdc7c.zh: 她在东京上野公园的樱花节期间卖食物。

Hi.

Thanks.

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_be256a589dfdc7c.zh: 但我认为东京是赏樱花节最好的地方之一。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_5ae2c09bfa64acc.text: Yesterday, I walked around a 3D art show.

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_5ae2c09bfa64acc.zh: 我相信那一定会让我思考很多。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_a6541d2bf498c4b.zh: 我爸爸妈妈想看一些体育比赛。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_a6541d2bf498c4b.text: There was basketball last year and also a car race.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_a6541d2bf498c4b.zh: 去年有篮球比赛，还有汽车赛。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_a6541d2bf498c4b.text: You can listen to traditional music,
but I decided to go to the fashion show.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_a6541d2bf498c4b.zh: 不过我决定去看时装秀。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_a6541d2bf498c4b.text: And after we finish watching the races and shows,
we'll go and eat some traditional food.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_a6541d2bf498c4b.zh: 我们会去吃一些传统食物。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_a6541d2bf498c4b.text: I hope you all have a great time.
So these international festivals with lots of music,
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_a6541d2bf498c4b.zh: 所以，这些有许多音乐的国际节日，

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_a6541d2bf498c4b.text: food and fashion are providing a different type of experience for people.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_a6541d2bf498c4b.zh: 食物和时尚，正为人们提供不同类型的体验。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_a6541d2bf498c4b.text: Next week, we'll be looking at...

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_1e27350ae743f90.text: Paul,
you have cousins in the US, don't you?
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_1e27350ae743f90.zh: 你在美国有表兄弟姐妹，对吧？

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_1e27350ae743f90.text: What's your opinion?
Which is the best North American holiday or celebration?
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_1e27350ae743f90.zh: 北美最好的节日或庆典是哪一个？

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_1e27350ae743f90.text: Hmm.
Well,
I like Independence Day in the US because of the fireworks,
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_1e27350ae743f90.zh: 我喜欢美国独立日，因为有烟花，

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_1e27350ae743f90.text: and New Year's Eve often has fireworks too.
But I think the best holiday is Thanksgiving.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_1e27350ae743f90.zh: 但我认为最好的节日是感恩节。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_1e27350ae743f90.text: Why do you like Thanksgiving?
Everyone has something to be thankful for,
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_1e27350ae743f90.zh: 每个人都有值得感恩的事情，

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_1e27350ae743f90.text: so everyone can celebrate it.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_1e27350ae743f90.zh: 所以每个人都可以庆祝它。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_1e27350ae743f90.text: Both the US and Canada celebrate it.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_1e27350ae743f90.zh: 美国和加拿大都会庆祝感恩节。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_1e27350ae743f90.text: Really?
How do people celebrate it?
Well, most people get together with family and friends and have a big meal.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_1e27350ae743f90.zh: 大多数人会和家人朋友聚在一起，吃一顿丰盛的大餐。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_1e27350ae743f90.text: What do they eat?
They usually eat a traditional meal.
This is usually a delicious turkey with stuffing for the main dish.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_1e27350ae743f90.zh: 主菜通常是一只美味的火鸡，配以填料。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_1e27350ae743f90.text: You should try it.
Most traditional Thanksgiving meals have food which is from the Americas,
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_1e27350ae743f90.zh: 大多数传统感恩节餐食都有美洲出产的食物，

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_1e27350ae743f90.text: like potatoes,
corn and cranberries.
For dessert they eat pumpkin pie,
but some people prefer different kinds of pie,
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_1e27350ae743f90.zh: 但有些人更喜欢其他种类的派，

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_1e27350ae743f90.text: like apple.

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_6051657fddfdd46.text: Is the food the same in both countries?
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_6051657fddfdd46.zh: 两个国家的食物一样吗？

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_6051657fddfdd46.text: Actually, there are some differences in the food.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_6051657fddfdd46.zh: 事实上，食物有一些不同。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_6051657fddfdd46.text: In Canada, for example, the pumpkin pie is spicy,
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_6051657fddfdd46.zh: 例如，在加拿大，南瓜派是辣的，

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_6051657fddfdd46.text: but in the US it's sweet.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_6051657fddfdd46.zh: 但在美国是甜的。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_6051657fddfdd46.text: I like the American style with whipped cream.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_6051657fddfdd46.zh: 我喜欢加鲜奶油的美式做法。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_6051657fddfdd46.text: You have to try it.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_6051657fddfdd46.zh: 你一定得尝尝。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_6051657fddfdd46.text: Another dish which is different is the stuffing.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_6051657fddfdd46.zh: 另一种不同的菜是填料。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_6051657fddfdd46.text: For instance, in Canada stuffing is often made from rice or bread, but in the southern US it could be made from cornbread.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_6051657fddfdd46.zh: 例如，在加拿大，填料常用米或面包做成；但在美国南部，可能用玉米面包做。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_6051657fddfdd46.text: In the eastern US,
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_6051657fddfdd46.zh: 在美国东部，

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_6051657fddfdd46.text: sometimes oysters are used in the stuffing.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_6051657fddfdd46.zh: 有时会在填料里加入牡蛎。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_6051657fddfdd46.text: That all sounds delicious.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_6051657fddfdd46.zh: 听起来都很美味。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_6051657fddfdd46.text: Are there any special decorations for Thanksgiving?
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_6051657fddfdd46.zh: 感恩节有什么特别装饰吗？

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_6051657fddfdd46.text: Well,
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_6051657fddfdd46.zh: 嗯，

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_6051657fddfdd46.text: people often decorate their dinner tables and homes with things such as colourful leaves,
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_6051657fddfdd46.zh: 人们常用彩色树叶等物品装饰餐桌和家，

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_6051657fddfdd46.text: autumn vegetables and candles.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_6051657fddfdd46.zh: 秋季蔬菜和蜡烛。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_6051657fddfdd46.text: The decorations usually have autumn colours like red, yellow and orange.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_6051657fddfdd46.zh: 装饰通常采用红、黄、橙等秋天的颜色。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_6051657fddfdd46.text: Do people give gifts or do some special activities?
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_6051657fddfdd46.zh: 人们会送礼物或做特别活动吗？

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_6051657fddfdd46.text: Well, people don't really give gifts, but there are some special activities.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_6051657fddfdd46.zh: 人们其实不太送礼物，但有一些特别活动。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_6051657fddfdd46.text: For example, both countries celebrate with parades, with marching bands and people in costumes.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_6051657fddfdd46.zh: 例如，两个国家都会举行游行，有行进乐队和穿戏服的人。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_6051657fddfdd46.text: It's also traditional to watch sport on TV.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_6051657fddfdd46.zh: 在电视上看体育比赛也是传统。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_2b817d3ad85690d.text: It sounds like the celebration is almost the same in both countries.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_2b817d3ad85690d.zh: 听起来两个国家的庆祝活动几乎一样。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_2b817d3ad85690d.text: Well, there are some differences between Canadian and American Thanksgiving.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_2b817d3ad85690d.zh: 加拿大和美国的感恩节还是有一些不同。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_2b817d3ad85690d.text: Well, for instance, in Canada the holiday is celebrated on the second Monday in October,
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_2b817d3ad85690d.zh: 例如，在加拿大，这个节日在十月的第二个星期一庆祝，

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_2b817d3ad85690d.text: but in the US it's on the fourth Thursday in November.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_2b817d3ad85690d.zh: 而在美国是在十一月的第四个星期四。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_2b817d3ad85690d.text: Another difference is that in Canada people enjoy small local parades.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_2b817d3ad85690d.zh: 另一个差别是，加拿大人喜欢小型的当地游行。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_2b817d3ad85690d.text: In the US they have a huge parade in New York City and people all over the US watch it on TV.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_2b817d3ad85690d.zh: 美国则在纽约市举行大型游行，全国的人都会在电视上观看。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_2b817d3ad85690d.text: People in the New York parade sometimes wear costumes.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_2b817d3ad85690d.zh: 纽约游行中的人有时会穿戏服。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_2b817d3ad85690d.text: One last difference is that each country has different reasons for the holiday.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_2b817d3ad85690d.zh: 最后一个差别是，每个国家庆祝这个节日的理由不同。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_2b817d3ad85690d.text: In Canada the holiday celebrates the autumn harvest,
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_2b817d3ad85690d.zh: 在加拿大，这个节日庆祝秋收，

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_2b817d3ad85690d.text: but Americans celebrate the autumn harvest and remembering the Native Americans helping settlers hunt and learn to grow food.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_2b817d3ad85690d.zh: 而美国人庆祝秋收，也纪念曾帮助定居者狩猎和学习种植食物的美洲原住民。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_2b817d3ad85690d.text: That sounds like a lot of fun.
I want to go to a Thanksgiving celebration in both countries.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_2b817d3ad85690d.zh: 我想去两个国家体验感恩节庆祝活动。
